findings: Actual TryGetCurrent reads a thread_local pointer initialized to null.
Isolate entry/exit preserves native per-thread nested entry ownership separately from the current context.
Context entry/exit selects and restores the current context through the actual handle-scope implementer; InContext checks that current context, not merely isolate presence.
SetCurrentIsolateScope is a saved-pointer native scope; it does not itself establish a current context.
